Name: Ribbed Knit Sweater
Description: A close-gauge rib knit cut with a relaxed drop shoulder. Cotton-wool blend that holds its shape through repeated wear and washes clean without pilling.

Name: Tailored Wide-Leg Trouser
Description: A high-rise trouser with a clean fall through the leg. Finished with a hidden hook closure and a single pressed crease front and back.

Name: Oversized Cotton Shirt
Description: Midweight cotton poplin cut with room through the body and a dropped shoulder seam. Reads dressed-up or thrown over a tee.

Description: A long, structured overcoat in a heavyweight wool blend. Notch lapel, welt pockets, and a full body lining for cold-weather travel.

Name: Relaxed Cargo Trouser
Description: Garment-dyed cotton twill with patch pockets and a tapered leg. Sits at the natural waist with room to move through the thigh.

Name: Everyday Crew Tee
Description: 220gsm combed cotton with a slightly boxy body and a ribbed crew neck that keeps its shape wash after wash.

Name: Structured Canvas Tote
Description: Heavy waxed canvas with leather handles and a reinforced base. Sized to carry a laptop and a change of clothes without sagging.

Name: Leather Card Holder
Description: Full-grain leather folded from a single piece and hand-stitched at the edge. Ages into a deeper patina with use.
